name: Abunai Kojin Satsueikai
source:
The main character is a guy who makes a living taking firsthand videos of sex and selling them. This time his target is a normal girl named Mika whom he fell for after getting to know her as a model on a cell phone website. He calls her for a one on one photo shoot in order to set up the camera. At first he just takes normal poses, but slowly he makes her expose more and more skin until she finally ends up baring it all.

Thanks to all the multiple choice selection screens, the developments in the latter half vary greatly. Will you continue with your original intent to deceive and threaten her in order to nail her, or do you embrace her loving heart and head toward a path of true love? It might just show you how much of a sexual beast you are!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039488.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一个靠拍摄性爱一手视频并出售为生的男人。这次他的目标是一个名叫美香的普通女孩，他在手机网站上认识了作为模特的她后就爱上了她。他约她进行一对一的拍摄，以便架设相机。起初他只拍普通的姿势，但慢慢地让她露出越来越多的肌肤，直到她最终全部袒露。

多亏了所有的多选屏幕，后半段的发展大不相同。你是会继续原本的打算欺骗威胁她以便得手，还是会接受她充满爱意的心走向真爱之路？它也许会展示你到底有多像一头色狼！
